summary: Dirt pull-off beside the reserve road, backing onto bush, homes about 50 m off.
reasons: Bare dirt pull-off meets road edge
Cars parked there in QLD image

drivers.traffic: Quiet reserve access road, minor local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on it; no signs in the data.

flags: Slope under the pin 4-25%; pull-off itself about 3%
Mapped gate 20 m away, with a way round
Roundabout lighting and residents may pass
sun_shade: Open dirt with trees to the east and north giving morning shade.
